_comment: Accepted accessibility violations, each tied to the issue that removes it.
This file exists so the gate can land RED-FREE without pretending the site
is clean. It is deliberately hostile to rot:
- a violation NOT listed here fails the gate immediately, so nothing new
can slip in behind the waiver;
- a rule listed here that produces ZERO violations ALSO fails, so the
waiver cannot outlive the fix and quietly keep granting permission.
The only correct end state is this list being empty and the mechanism

waived.why: Small text below 4.5:1 across the superseded pages' --ink-60 token, the --accent used as 10px text, and low-alpha inline colours on the redesigned pages. Being fixed at the design-system level rather than page by page.
training.html's .price-table scrolls horizontally at narrow widths but is not keyboard focusable, so a keyboard-only user cannot reach its right-hand columns.
